docTitle: How I work full time while doing a master's abroad (Instagram)

slides.title: How I work full time while doing a *master's* abroad
slides.sub: I'm a software developer in Estonia, and I'm also doing a full-time master's. These are the things that help me.

slides.title: Check if students can *work* where you study
slides.body: In Estonia there's no limit on the hours an international student can work. You still have to stay a full-time student, because dropping to part-time can put your residence permit at risk.

slides.title: Know your *credits* before the semester gets busy
slides.body: In Estonia, full-time means at least 45 ECTS by the end of each study year. Your school may count it its own way, so check your study rules early.

slides.title: Give your thesis and internship *more time*
slides.body: If you think something big will take six to eight weeks, plan for ten.

slides.title: Block your week from what *can't move*
slides.body: I put in my classes, deadlines and work meetings first. Then my study time gets its own slot, like Tuesday evening for reading.

slides.title: Keep work and school on *one calendar*
slides.body: With two calendars it feels like you have two 24 hours. You only have one.

slides.title: Study leave in Estonia is up to *30 days* a year
slides.body: 20 of those days are paid at your average wage when it's for formal studies, like a master's.

slides.title: Tell your manager *early*
slides.body: If you know a busy school week is coming, tell your manager before it starts. It's easier for everyone to plan around it.

slides.title: The kind of job you have *matters*
slides.body: A job with fixed hours and a job with flexible hours feel very different when you also have classes. Think about which one you can study with.

slides.title: Meal prep will *save your life*
slides.body: Cook on the weekend, so you're not cooking on a Wednesday evening after work and class.

slides.title: Protect your *sleep*
slides.body: It's easy to cut sleep when you're doing both, but your job and your studies both need you rested.

slides.title: Which of these do you *already do*?
slides.body: I talk through all of them in my video on working full time while doing a master's abroad.
